page_title: MON 1-0 UNI | B. Monchengladbach v Union Berlin 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' We are about to witness a subsitution. Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) for Alassane Plea.
90+6' 1 - 0 Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) heads the ball into the middle after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
90+3' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
90+3' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) launches a cross from the corner, but Frederik Ronnow is alert to thwart the effort.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
86' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) latches onto a pass and lets fly at goal from the edge of the box. The shot beats the keeper but smashes against the left post. Good effort!
83' Dangerous play by Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin). Daniel Schlager blows his whistle for a foul.
81' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
81' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
79' Substitution. Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Janik Haberer walks off.
79' Bo Svensson prepares a substitution. Jordan Siebatcheu is replaced by Tim Skarke (Union Berlin).
78' Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) makes a strong challenge and Daniel Schlager blows for a foul.
76' That's the end of the game for Philipp Sander, who is replaced by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach).
76' Nathan Ngoumou just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) replaces him.
76' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
75' Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Kevin Stoger walks off the pitch to be replaced by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach).
72' Bo Svensson has decided to substitute Benedict Hollerbach and he is replaced by Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin).
69' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
67' The booking goes to Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach).
67' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
64' A player from Union Berlin brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
62' Today's match ends for Woo-Yeong Jeong who will be replaced by Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin).
61' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
60' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
55' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
51' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
50' The free kick from long range, taken by Union Berlin, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
49' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Daniel Schlager blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Bo Svensson gives a chance to Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) and Tom Rothe is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Daniel Schlager has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
42' The ball breaks to Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) after a scramble in the box, but his first-time effort is immediately blocked.
42' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from B. Monchengladbach comes to nothing.
38' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Frederik Ronnow intercepts the ball.
36' A pass by Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

35' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Frederik Ronnow, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
34' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Daniel Schlager who sees an offensive foul.
31' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

31' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Union Berlin.
28' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
26' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) receives a neat pass inside the box with his back to goal, swivels and hits a powerful shot that goes narrowly over the crossbar.
23' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle as Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
22' A lofted cross from Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
22' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
17' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) wasted a golden chance to score after he found some space inside the box and unluckily volleyed the ball narrowly over the bar.
16' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniel Schlager has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

11' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Moritz Nicolas, who pulls off a stunning save!
10' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) controls a cross from Tom Rothe inside the box, but sidefoots the ball just wide of the left post.
7' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
6' A pass from Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) is intercepted by Moritz Nicolas and the move breaks down.
5' A pass by Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
3' The free kick into the penalty area from Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) is cleared.
2' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort towards the bottom left corner and Moritz Nicolas easily makes the save.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. B. Monchengladbach will have the kick-off.
Daniel Schlager is the one to supervise the game today.
